item.title: 1.2+ Update
item.content:encoded:
@Announcements MEW - 1.2+ Update

ADDED:

  • Revised Mojave
  • Desert Interiors - Atmos Compatible Version
  • Freeside Interiors
  • Simple AI Merge
  • Enhanced Creatures
  • Revamped Fiend Headgear
  • LARP - Legion Armor Revamp Project
  • Better Transitions
  • Stim Your Friends - Fallout 4 Style NPC Stim - ESPless
  • Sweet Scarcity - (Values should be similar to famine but may be tweaked in the future)
  • ySI - Additional Icons
  • Fallout 3 Karma
  • Added support for Epic Games version
  • Added Performance Preset - (More info on the Performance & Optimisation page)

REMOVED:

  • ML Utilities Checker - (MEW Patches now contains a version made by Qolore7)
  • CBBE due to Enhanced Creatures changes being preferred
  • Famine - Replaced by Sweet Scarcity
  • New Vegas Suburban Overhaul - Due to conflicts with Revised Mojave
  • Lived in AIO - Due to conflicts with Revised Mojave
  • 16 LOD mods that are only required for LOD generation
  • Consumables Widget - Issue with consumables staying on screen after death
  • Bash Perks Hidden - Changes integrated into MEW - Tweaks
  • PerkOut - SkilledAlt - Changes integrated into MEW - Tweaks
  • Vanilla Underwear Replacer

TWEAKED:

  • Fixed small issue with Pipboy Holo Panel ESPless breaking when selecting unarmed with Quick Select in power armour
  • MEW - Patches
    • Includes utility mod checker by Qolore7
    • Fixed issue with Pyromaniac perk not using the explosives skill
    • Changed some Lock difficulties
    • Made levelling up actually 50% slower
  • MEW - INI's and Configs
    • Reduced base sprint speed to 60% but boosted agility speed scaling
    • Added Enhanced Creatures INI

UPDATED:

  • New Vegas Script Extender (NVSE xNVSE)
  • NVTF - (Stutter should be reduced further)
  • Meshes and Collision - Totally Enhanced Nifs (MAC-TEN)
  • YUPDate - YUP Tweaks and Fixes
  • Vanilla Plus Terrain
  • MAPMO - Main and Pause Menus Overhaul
  • Companion Map Icons - ESPless
  • PipBoy UI Tweaks
  • 3D Grenade Indicator - ESPless
  • Sleep Wait Hardcore Needs
  • ySI - Contextual Prompts
  • Local Map Overhaul
  • Enhanced Movement
  • Locks Overhaul
  • Ghouls Inflict Radiation Damage - ESPless
  • Point That Somewhere Else
  • Raiderfolk Mutated Raiders
  • NPCs Sprint kNVSE
  • Lived-In Strip
  • Mojave Scenery Overhaul
  • Curated Tweaks and Restorations
  • Goodies
  • FPGE - Functional Post Game Ending
  • Advanced 3rd Person Camera ESPless
  • Radiation Visuals - ESPless
  • Crafting and Repair Animations
  • Explosion Reactions - ESPless
  • Vanilla Script Micro-Optimizations
  • MEW - Object LOD Output - (New rock texture colour and new black rock mesh exclusive to MEW)

SAFE TO UPDATE MID-SAVE - (Hopefully)
